welcome.title: Welcome!
welcome.intro: I am Lumee, your digital companion in the emergency department.
welcome.description: I am here to help you make the best use of your waiting time. Together, we can prepare for your doctor's visit by asking about your condition. I can also answer your questions about the process and provide a map for orientation.
welcome.lookForward: We can start whenever you are ready.
